definition: One JSON file in R2 for each run. It lists each capture of the run with its image and its comparison result. D1 holds only a pointer to it.
The list of the captures of one run that the capture adapter writes and the Submit job sends to the service. The run inventory holds a copy of it: the embedded manifest.
The part of the page that one screenshot covers: x, y, width, and height. It is in the rendering profile of each capture.
A short list at the start of the proposed inventory. It holds one time a value that many captures have, such as a variant. A row names the value by its position in the list.
The capture count that the contract plans for: about 10,580 captures in one run, which was 10 times the count when the number was written.
An earlier decision of the maintainer: numeric limits wait for measurements and a later approval.
